regime_read: The strongest measured convergence sits in enterprise technology and semiconductors, but several signals face near-term earnings risk and the track record has only two scored observations. IBM and MU offer the cleanest non-extended alignment; MSFT has credible convergence but is already extended.
regime_read_zh: 目前最强的可测量多信号汇聚集中在企业科技与半导体，但多个标的临近财报，而且历史记录仅有两条已评分样本。IBM 与 MU 是最清晰且未过度延伸的信号组合；MSFT 的汇聚也较可信，但股价已经过度延伸。

theses.thesis: Five independent channels align: sharply accelerating federal-contract activity, positive insider positioning, a large patent cluster, developer momentum and model-download momentum [gov_contract_accel] [insider_mspr] [patent_cluster] [github_momentum] [hf_model_momentum]. Relative strength is positive but not extended, preserving an entry, although earnings in four trading days create material event risk.
theses.thesis_zh: 五条独立渠道形成一致信号：联邦合同活动显著加速、内部人仓位积极、专利集群规模较大、开发者动能以及模型下载动能 [gov_contract_accel] [insider_mspr] [patent_cluster] [github_momentum] [hf_model_momentum]。相对强度为正但尚未过度延伸，因此仍有入场空间；不过四个交易日后公布财报，事件风险显著。
second_order: Enterprise AI infrastructure — IBM's contract and developer momentum implies continued spending on hybrid-cloud integration and supporting data infrastructure.
Government IT services — accelerating federal awards can support implementation, cybersecurity and systems-integration demand.
theses.dissent: The convergence may reflect backward-looking contract awards and research activity rather than accelerating commercial revenue, while imminent earnings could reset expectations.

falsifier.text: Federal-contract acceleration reverses and developer or model-download momentum weakens without corresponding commercial growth.

theses.thesis: MU has the broadest convergence count in the pack: government grants, insider strength, a substantial patent cluster and a dense analyst-upgrade cluster align with bullish retail sentiment [gov_grant] [insider_mspr] [patent_cluster] [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [stocktwits_bull]. Its negative 60-day relative performance means the signal is not being chased, but affiliation with Ro Khanna is qualitative rather than evidence of a policy outcome [actor:Ro Khanna].
theses.thesis_zh: MU 拥有证据包中最广的汇聚渠道数：政府补助、内部人强势、大型专利集群及密集的分析师上调，与看多的散户情绪相互印证 [gov_grant] [insider_mspr] [patent_cluster] [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [stocktwits_bull]。其过去60日相对表现为负，意味着当前并非追高；但与 Ro Khanna 的关联仅属定性信息，不能视为政策结果证据 [actor:Ro Khanna]。
second_order: Semiconductor equipment — stronger memory investment would support fabrication and packaging-tool demand.
AI server supply chain — improving memory demand would benefit high-bandwidth-memory packaging and server-component ecosystems.
theses.dissent: Analyst and retail bullishness can be crowded, while grants and patents may not offset a cyclical deterioration in memory pricing or demand.

falsifier.text: Memory demand weakens while grant acceleration, insider strength and analyst revisions cease to improve.

theses.thesis: The healthcare signal is internally coherent: Phase 3 starts, an FDA approval and a label expansion align with a special-situation catalyst [clinical_phase3_start] [fda_approval] [fda_label_expansion] [special_situation]. The shares are not extended, but one clinical halt and earnings in thirteen trading days keep conviction low.
theses.thesis_zh: 该医疗保健信号内部一致：三期临床启动、FDA 批准及适应症标签扩展，与特殊事件催化相互呼应 [clinical_phase3_start] [fda_approval] [fda_label_expansion] [special_situation]。股价尚未过度延伸，但存在一项临床暂停且十三个交易日后公布财报，因此维持低置信度。
second_order: Clinical-research services — numerous Phase 3 starts imply demand for trial execution, monitoring and data services.
Drug manufacturing services — approvals and label expansion can increase commercialization and production-support requirements.
theses.dissent: Regulatory milestones may already be reflected in expectations, and the clinical halt could signal broader pipeline execution risk.

falsifier.text: Additional material clinical halts emerge or approved and expanded indications fail to produce measurable commercialization progress.

theses.thesis: Developer usage, model-download activity and patent formation align with disclosed political holdings and a positive Trump-linked signal [github_momentum] [patent_cluster] [affiliation] [trump] [actor:Nancy Pelosi] [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene] [actor:Michael McCaul]. The shares are not extended on the supplied 60-day relative-strength measure, but retail buzz is less independent than the underlying developer channels and should not carry equal weight [retail_buzz].
theses.thesis_zh: 开发者使用、模型下载活动及专利形成，与已披露的政治人物持仓和偏多的特朗普关联信号形成汇聚 [github_momentum] [patent_cluster] [affiliation] [trump] [actor:Nancy Pelosi] [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene] [actor:Michael McCaul]。按所提供的60日相对强度衡量，股价尚未过度延伸；但散户热度与底层开发者渠道的独立性较弱，不应给予同等权重 [retail_buzz]。
second_order: Advanced semiconductor manufacturing — sustained accelerator demand implies continued leading-edge fabrication and packaging demand.
Data-center power and cooling — accelerator deployment increases electricity, thermal-management and facility requirements.
High-bandwidth memory — AI accelerators require memory-intensive system architectures.
theses.dissent: Political holdings and retail attention may be stale or sentiment-driven, while strong ecosystem activity does not guarantee favorable incremental margins.

falsifier.text: Developer and model-download momentum rolls over while accelerator demand and patent activity fail to translate into continued ecosystem growth.

theses.thesis: App demand, patent activity, the Sam Altman partnership link and a positive Trump-linked signal point in the same direction [app_demand] [patent_cluster] [actor:Sam Altman] [trump]. However, 60-day relative performance is above the extension threshold, so the underlying read is constructive but the entry is gone.
theses.thesis_zh: 应用需求、专利活动、与 Sam Altman 的合作关系以及偏多的特朗普关联信号方向一致 [app_demand] [patent_cluster] [actor:Sam Altman] [trump]。然而，其60日相对表现已超过过度延伸阈值，因此基本信号虽偏积极，但当前入场机会已经消失。
second_order: Cloud data-center infrastructure — sustained application demand implies continued compute, networking and storage requirements.
Data-center power and cooling — cloud and AI capacity additions increase power-delivery and thermal-management needs.
Enterprise software integrators — broader AI application adoption creates implementation and migration work.
theses.dissent: The convergence is partly relationship- and sentiment-based, while the extended price already discounts substantial AI and cloud execution.

falsifier.text: App demand weakens and AI partnership activity fails to produce sustained cloud or enterprise-software demand after the shares normalize.
